KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have had enough of this drab, medieval aesthetic. It's time for a change. I want our kingdom to be the most...futuristic (he) place in all the land.

ZORVATH
(nervously)
But, your majesty, are you certain? Our people are accustomed to the traditional (he) ways.

KING
(firmly)
I am the king (he), and I will not be swayed. I want our kingdom to be a beacon of...vaporwave (he) excellence.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king (he) is surrounded by his loyal subjects, all of whom are dressed in the most outlandish (they) attire. There's a knight in a neon pink and green armor, a merchant in a flowing (he) gown, and a peasant in a pair of (his) oversized, novelty sunglasses.

KING
(to his subjects)
I want our kingdom to be a place where the past (it) meets the future (he). Where the grandeur (she) of medieval times is juxtaposed with the...futuristic (he) sensibilities of the vaporwave (they).

The subjects look at each other in confusion (they), but the king (he) is undeterred.

CUT TO:

EXT. KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed (it) overnight. The buildings are now adorned with (his) garish, neon lights, and the streets are filled with (their) strange, futuristic contraptions. There are hoverbikes (they) zipping by, and (his) robots (they) doing (his) bidding.

KING
(to Zorvath)
See, my advisor? I told you (he) it would work.

ZORVATH
(skeptically)
But, your majesty, this is...surreal (he).

KING
(laughing)
That's the point (she)! We're not just a medieval kingdom (it); we're a...vaporwave (they) utopia.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king (he) is now surrounded by (his) subjects, all of whom are dressed in the most outlandish (they) attire. There's a knight in a neon pink and green armor, a merchant in a flowing (he) gown, and a peasant in a pair of (his) oversized, novelty sunglasses.

KING
(to his subjects)
We are the pioneers (they) of a new era (he). An era where the boundaries (they) between past and future (he) are blurred.

The subjects cheer (they), and the king (he) smiles (he) triumphantly.
